Santa Croce — Florence, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Piazza Santa Croce is a major basilica and tourist square that is calm by day. At night it is one of Florence's main movida hubs, and Via de' Benci (immediately adjacent) is named in the official Prefecture 'zona rossa'. La Nazione has documented recurring weekend disorder here ('le notti folli di piazza Santa Croce') including brawls, unlicensed street sellers of alcohol and drugs, and residents/police calling for a fixed Saturday-night police presence due to a lack of camera coverage and consistent controls. Sources checked: La Nazione, 'Le notti folli di piazza Santa Croce. Risse, venditori di alcol e droga'; FirenzeDintorni, 'Nessun controllo e alcol a volontà, a Santa Croce la movida è senza regole'; Controradio, Prefecture 'zone rosse' list including Via de' Benci.
